title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood

episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
episodes.overview: Luffy defends an old pet food shop guarded by a loyal dog against Buggy's beast tamer Mohji.

title: Chainsaw Man
